ValidationRule.description: QCC: The selected Recovery Type is only available for Cases of Type "Medical - Assistance Provided" or "Medical - Patient and should be chosen by only Sydney users
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Only_to_be_chosen_by_sydney_users__c, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect',OR(Text(Type__c)= 'Space available upgrade', Text(Type__c)='Firm space upgrade'),
Text($User.Location__c) <>'Sydney', OR( $Profile.Name = "Qantas CC Consultant", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Hobart", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Manila", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Capetown", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Suva", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Auckland", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Mumbai" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This recovery is not available for this Case Type.
